Name: Charcoal Kiln Tweaks
Author: pomarf
Description:
[b][u][size=4]About this mod:[/size][/u][/b]
Charcoal kiln recipe has been changed, and a hardwood recipe has also been added.
[list]
[*]3 Wood - > 1 Coal (30 In-Game Minutes)[/*]
[*]1 Hardwood - > 3 Coal (1 In-Game Hour)
[color=#a4c2f4]Amounts are editable via config or GMCM.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]Multiplayer:[/size][/u][/b]
As far as I can tell it should work in multiplayer, as long as everyone has the mod installed.

[b][u][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/u][/b]
[url=https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/279100/typeset-the-shrug-%c2%af-%e3%83%84-%c2%af-emoji][color=#ffffff]¯\_(ツ)_/¯[/color][/url] 
I don't see why it should have any issues with anything besides other mods that change kiln recipes.

[b][color=#980000][size=4]Disclaimer:[/size][/color]
[/b][i]I highly doubt I will ever update this mod, I tend to make things and forget about them for a few years.[/i]
[color=#980000][u][b]So because of that I have included the raw ModEntry.cs as an optional download for use in the following emergencies:[/b][/u][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#980000][b]If this mod stops working in the future and you want to update it, just maybe throw me some credit.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#980000][b]Or if you wanna use this mod as part your own mod, again, credit would be pretty cool.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#980000][b]Or if you are just curious and wanna see how it works, that is also a completely valid option.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list]
